args.note_markdown:
**What happened:** C2 tripped ~05:01 (standby offline) [C2]. From 05:05 both CH4 probes [TT-401][TT-402] and both CH5 probes [TT-501][TT-502] rose from 2.1 to ~7.4 C, with probes agreeing within 0.05 C. The excursion is real, not a sensor fault. WO-1042 (TT-401 calibration) [WO-1042] is unrelated and I did not amend it.

**Done:**
- QA holds: L-2231 [QH-0001], L-2232 [QH-0002].
- Raised WO-1043 (P1) on C2 [WO-1043].
- Drafted isolation permit [PD-0001]. A person must authorise it.

**Awaiting Shift Supervisor approval:**
- [AP-0001] L-2231 dispatch 06:15 to 09:30.
- [AP-0002] L-2232 dispatch 07:28 to 10:30.

**Next physical checks:**
- Technician to diagnose the C2 trip and restore cooling.
- Handheld product temperature checks in CH4 and CH5.
- QA to assess time above limit (since ~05:05) before any release.
